name: essms-root
description: Ethiopian Secondary School Management System - Root

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: start cmd /k "cd server && npm install && npm run dev" && start cmd /k "cd client && npm install && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
